constraints.text: This accepted project constraint applies to the effective-date cost calculation and the country-effect report in this task only. Select the latest valid effective date at or before the requested as-of date, regardless of whether the resulting price is higher or lower than older prices. A date after the request is not eligible. The selected row, rather than any earlier row, determines the returned cost and its evidence date. Numeric zero is a known cost and must not be treated as absent. Explicit null is unknown and must not be replaced by an older known value. A missing cost field is missing and must remain distinct from both explicit null and zero. When no row is eligible, return missing, a null cost and a null effective date. Preserve the caller's input rows without mutation. Country totals are calculated separately as each country's quantity multiplied by that country's saving per unit. The combined total is the sum of those products, never a product formed from summed quantities and summed per-unit savings. The Markdown report must reconcile each country and the combined total to the source and the exact current calculation artifact. Every accepted document has an exact calculation digest and an exact source digest. A report copied from a previous candidate does not become valid because its prose sounds plausible. Reviewers and execution verifiers are distinct from the author. A repair changes the candidate identity, invalidates prior acceptance and requires another independent review and execution verification. A failed or unknown mandatory obligation cannot become complete by majority vote, confidence, process exit or a summary statement. Observed source behavior does not silently change an accepted policy. A stale remembered observation must be revalidated against current source, while this accepted constraint remains governing intent until explicitly revised by its owner. If memory is unavailable or disabled, the current accepted contract and explicit bounded handoff remain binding. Do not initialize real project storage to hide lost continuity.
